data.headline: Nvidia to take Intel's spot on Dow Jones Industrial Average
data.summary: (Reuters) -Intel will be replaced by Nvidia on the blue-chip Dow Jones Industrial Average index  after a 25-year run, underscoring the shift in the chipmaking market and marking another setback for the struggling semiconductor firm.  Nvidia will join the index next week along with paint-maker Sherwin-Williams , which will replace Dow, S&P Dow Jones Indices said on Friday.  Once the dominant force in chipmaking, Intel has in recent years ceded its manufacturing edge to rival TSMC and missed out on the generative artificial intelligence boom after missteps including passing on an investment in ChatGPT-owner OpenAI.
